payload.title: Thread pages: <threadBase>/<key>/ rendered from the per-thread JSON, homePage.forum settings, threads include links
payload.description:
Repo: **Papyrus**. Phase 1 of PPY-452419. Every public thread gets its own static page, read-only, from the per-thread JSON that #907 already writes.

## Files
- `src/papyrus_content/home_page/settings.py`: add `forum` to `home_page_settings_from_mapping`: `ForumSettings(thread_base="conversations", index_page_size=50, posting=None)`; unknown keys are a build error naming the key (same style as `ThreadsSettings`). `threadBase` is validated like a section `base` (`projection/standard/config.py` `_check_section_fronts` / reserved prefixes `_data`, `_plugins`, `_papyrus`, `_next`, `api`; `newsroom` reserved on CMS-style edges, `docs/home-page.md` ~69).
- `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/home_page.py` (`HomePageSource`): read `_data/home-page/threads/<key>.json` (shape: `{key,title,anchor:{kind:"reference",key,title}|{kind:"story",url,title},messages:[{key,at,edited,text,author:{handle}|{label}}]}`) and `threads.json` for the list.
- New `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/forum_pages.py`: `thread_page(context, thread) -> Page` and `forum_index_pages(context) -> list[Page]` (index is the next task; put the module here so both share it). Register in `projector.py` next to the section fronts (#908, `home_page_blocks.py` / `page_ledger.py` pattern), emitted through `add()` so the `.md` twin and `llms.txt` entry come for free.
- `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/home_page_components.py`: a `threads` include card links to `/<threadBase>/<key>/` (today it links nowhere; `docs/home-page.md` ~73 "Nothing reads the per-thread files yet").
- `assets/papyrus-home-page.css`: thread page styles: a header (title, anchor card reusing the Reference `row` card or a Story line), then one flat block per Message (`rounded-xl`, background tone), author handle with a Lucide `user` icon or "Editor" label with `badge-check`, time as `<time datetime>`, "edited" as text with a `pencil` icon. No borders.
- Digest: the page digest folds in the thread file's digest (as `_knowledge_inputs()` does), so the incremental re-render (#906/#909) rewrites a thread page only when its file changed; `owns_page_key` must own `<threadBase>/` pages so reconcile deletes a page whose thread stopped being public (`task.py` `_stale_thread_files` already deletes the JSON; mirror it for the page).

## Gherkin (`features_backend/forum-thread-pages.feature`)
Feature: Public thread pages
  Scenario: A public thread renders as a page with its Messages in sequence
  Scenario: The page has a Markdown twin and an llms.txt entry
  Scenario: A thread that is no longer public loses its page on the next snapshot
  Scenario: A site without homePage.forum renders no thread pages and the threads include links nowhere
  Scenario: threadBase may not be a reserved prefix
  Scenario: No email, sub or UUID appears on a thread page (reader-privacy scan)

## Acceptance
- Fixture site in `procedures/newsroom/tests/` with two threads renders `conversations/<key>/index.html` and `.md`; `pytest procedures/newsroom/tests -k forum` green; byte-identical output for sites without `forum`.
- `docs/home-page.md` gains "Thread pages" (setting, URL shape, what is public).
- Depends on nothing open; shares `home_page.py` and `settings.py` with the forum index task, so the same implementer takes both or they land in order.
